desc.zh: 先看出“易混淆 = 可转 − 转后不变”，再按首个不同数位数可转数、从两端造出不变数。
desc.en: Discover that confusing = turnable − unchanged, then count turnable numbers by first differing digit and build unchanged ones from both ends.

complexity: O(d·5^(d/2)) time and space, d = number of digits of n (d ≤ 10: at most 7805 strings built)

concepts.name: Complement split of turnable numbers
concepts.description: Every turnable number is either unchanged by turning or confusing, so confusing = turnable − unchanged.

concepts.name: Counting below n by first differing digit
concepts.description: Group same-length numbers below n by the first position where they drop below n; stop at a digit that cannot turn.

concepts.name: Building strobogrammatic numbers from both ends
concepts.description: Choose turning pairs from the outside in, with a middle digit of 0, 1 or 8 for odd lengths.
